title: Rust native-address documentation still labels exact 0200 prefix as /7
description: Rust production code constructs and routes native addresses with byte 0 exactly 0x02, matching the resolved 0200::/8 profile, but lichen-core/src/addr.rs, lichen-gateway/src/config.rs, and gateway trust docs still describe 0200::/7 and /7 dispersion. This contradicts API invariants and can lead callers to admit 0x03 addresses. Update Rust documentation/comments to exact /8 terminology; do not alter canonical derivation bytes.
notes: 2026-09-08 OVERRIDING ADJUDICATION: Mark reaffirmed upstream Yggdrasil addressing EVERYWHERE. See upstream-yggdrasil-addressing in spec/decisions.jsonl and Settled Protocol Decisions in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md. This supersedes conflicting descriptions/notes/closures that bless SHA-512 native addressing, require preserving its bytes or IID-equality invariant, or call for blanket /8-to-/7 replacement. Node /128 MUST equal upstream AddrForKey(key) in 0200::/8. Routed /64, when used, MUST equal upstream SubnetForKey(key) in 0300::/8; 0200::/7 is the aggregate only. Standard link-local/multicast control retains scope. Follow exact pinned upstream source, not the abbreviated algorithm in old issues. Conformance oracle is independently obtained byte-equality vectors from yggdrasil-go revision 422836eeb21a99790caa286aa63d493bbc4766d7 (address.go/address_test.go), not agreement among LICHEN implementations. Report conflicting old tests/fixtures; do not weaken tests or generate expected results from code under test. Classify node versus subnet traffic correctly in routing/SCHC without altering upstream identities. Breaking address changes were already accepted in worker6-vdon. Existing migration work is incomplete; this annotation does not claim it is fixed. Scope origin: project-LICHEN-worker6-rmjn.
